Context: I. Table indicating income slabs and tax rates under Section 115-BAC (1-A).-

## I. Table indicating income slabs and tax rates under Section 115-BAC (1-A).-  
| Total income | Rate of tax |
| -------------------------------- | --------------- |
| Up to t 3,00,000 | Nil |
| From t 3,00,001 to t 6,00,000 | 5 per cent* |
| From t 6,00,001 to t 9,00,000 | 10 per cent* |
| From t 9,00,001 tot 12,00,000 | 15 per cent |
| From t 12,00,001 tot 15,00,000 | 20 per cent |
| Above t 15,00,000 | 30 per cent |
